title: Supplement Return Workflows: Connect Zendesk Requests to Warehouse and Finance Review
summary: Carry a supplement return from the Zendesk ticket to the authorized remedy, Extensiv receipt and NetSuite credit, with each stage holding its own state.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Connect a supplement return request to the original order, authorized return decision, actual receipt, and finance outcome. Support owns the customer conversation, receiving owns what physically arrives, and the approved policy determines disposition and refund. Do not equate a ticket status with returned stock or a completed financial adjustment.


Explore the complete[nutrition and supplements integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/nutrition-supplements) for the systems and processes around this guide.
